title: BLOODRUST
author: orx_hara
description:
Desire is a disease without remedy.

The subsumed underbelly of an iron-walled city provides a small reprieve from the merciless beyond. Navigate the computer logs of a man's desiderium as he roves the slums he once called home, and as he begins to learn just as much about himself as he begins to forget. Discover what it is he has given up, and all that he has left behind. Play the dark, dangerous Game where more than money is placed into bets.

BLOODRUST is a game about hunger, need, and entrapment within the confines of one’s world and mind alike.

36th Place Winner of the 2026 IFComp.

[For optimal gameplay, please play fullscreen on a Chrome browser on desktop or mobile.]

Content warning: suicidal ideation, depictions of blood and gore, simulated gambling, sexual themes, and strong language.
